ValidationRule.description: to make sure the user fills all mandatory fields when they select complaint has second issue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, !OR(ISPICKVAL( Status ,'Closed'), ISPICKVAL( Status ,'Withdrawn')), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR ( AND( IDR_Second_Issue__c, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Issue_Type_2__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Subsequent_Issue_2__c)), AND( ISBLANK(IDR_Product_2__c), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Escalated')), (ISBLANK(IDR_Account_Card_Policy_Number_2__c) && RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint') ) ), AND( NOT(IDR_Second_Issue__c), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Issue_Type_2__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Subsequent_Issue_2__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_Product_2__c)), NOT(OR(ISBLANK(IDR_Account_Card_Policy_Number_2__c), IDR_Account_Card_Policy_Number_2__c = 'N/A')) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All fields in the Second Issue section are mandatory if the complaint has second issue
